rationale: A wins because it gives the founder usable strategic choices, not just three polite funding-note wrappers. A's strongest line is the skeptical and pitch-shaping angle, "A 14-person startup is hiring 10 engineers to sell into utility procurement"; B's weakest strategic call is its next step, "journalist-fit-check on the founder-profile angle," which sends the founder toward the softest story because it is easiest, not because it is best. B is clean, but it plays defense; A actually tells the founder where the press risk and opportunity sit.
gaps_in_A: "Ex-Tesla Energy and NREL engineers are betting community solar breaks the grid before rooftop does" invents a rooftop comparison the update never supplied. That is a shiny sentence with no license.
"the community-solar bottleneck is software, not panels" overstates a category thesis. The update supports grid-strain software, not a market-wide bottleneck ranking.
"a climate seed fund put money behind the thesis" may be true, but the fund is unnamed and no investor thesis is disclosed. A asks for proof later, but the angle headline already spends the claim.
A has four viable angles, but the founder-profile angle is thin unless the founders have specific, checkable roles and a real origin story.
gaps_in_B: "someone who shipped commercial energy products at Tesla Energy and someone who did the underlying grid research at a national lab" is invented. Ex-employer is not proof of shipped products or underlying research.

"journalist-fit-check on the founder-profile angle. It is the only angle whose proof you already hold" is bad advice. The set does not yet hold roles, dates, or a founder story; it holds employer logos.

"Verdano raises $6M to keep community solar from straining the local grid" is serviceable but too close to a funding headline. It needs the harder category tension A found: whether the bottleneck is grid capacity and load timing.
B misses the skeptical procurement/headcount angle entirely. "plans to hire 10 engineers" is not just a refused hiring blurb; against three pilots and no revenue, it is the uncomfortable trade story.
